subject: FY 2018 Property Tax Classification
overview: The Council established the fiscal year 2018 property tax classification, electing a 175% tax shift while rejecting several exemptions, and referred a proposal to expand zoning abutter notifications to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Abutter Notification Referral
items.summary: Referred a proposed ordinance amendment to the Community Development Board that would expand the abutter notification radius to 400 feet and implement reverse 911 alerts for zoning appeals and special permits.

items.title: Public Hearing on FY 2018 Property Tax Allocation
items.summary: Opened a public hearing to receive testimony from the Board of Assessors and the public regarding the residential factor and potential tax exemptions for the upcoming fiscal year.

items.title: FY 2018 Residential Tax Factor
items.summary: Approved a residential factor of 0.906926, resulting in a 175% tax shift from residential to commercial and industrial property owners.

items.title: Residential and Commercial Tax Exemptions
items.summary: Voted not to adopt the residential exemption, the open space discount, or the small commercial exemption for fiscal year 2018.

items.title: Committee Reports and Sign Petition
items.summary: Approved reports concerning the Eversource transmission project and preliminary tax reviews, and granted a sign permit reversal for 91 Hicks Avenue.

items.title: Public Participation Regarding School Committee
items.summary: Limited a resident's comments regarding a School Committee matter after the chair and legal counsel cited open meeting law restrictions concerning the discussion of individuals' reputations without prior notice.

items.title: Infrastructure Resolutions and Dog Park Recognition
items.summary: Approved requests for pavement and catch basin repairs on High Street and Cook Circle and recognized the opening of the city's first dog park.
